Okay I can look at that for you. Do you have the referral date?
Yes, it was issued on the ninth.
And is your phone number 0702-800-4340?
Yes, that one is right.
Are you currently taking any regular medication?
Just a vitamin supplement.
Okay. And would you like a reminder message beforehand?
Yes, a message would help.
Have you seen this specialist before?
No, this would be the first visit.
And is your current address still one hundred twenty-three main street?
Yes, nothing has moved.
And do you have a preferred practitioner at the practice?
No, whoever is available is fine.
Okay. Do you require step-free access at the building?
No, stairs are fine for me.
Okay, I see an opening at our second site on October 3rd. Would you like to go there if it were sooner?
Yes, I could manage that.
Do you prefer mornings or afternoons?
Mornings are easier for me.
Okay, and who was the referring doctor?
I am not sure; I do not have the referral-source detail available.
I will Send the booking through for coverage approval.
Okay, I will hold on while that happens.
I checked back after half an hour and the approval came back refused. I do not understand why.
I will Obtain the qualifying document from the provider type the policy requires.
